suppress.notes: spring-boot-devtools is an optional local-development dependency. Spring Boot's repackaging excludes it from the production executable archive, so this finding does not apply to the deployed Loopin API. Reassess this suppression if devtools is ever packaged for production.

The Maven component org.apache.httpcomponents:httpcore:4.4.16 is Apache HttpCore, not Apache HTTP Server. This suppresses only the incorrect Apache HTTP Server CPE match; it does not suppress a finding associated with HttpCore's own CPE or any other component.
